runtime.change: step_hidden_batch_native now supplies a row-sized split-K workspace
runtime.reason: The NextN draft step ran the same row-bulk attention as the target but passed `split_workspace=None`, so past the split threshold it raised `long-context packed AR decode requires a row-sized split-K workspace`. change.diagnostic: hipengine/speculative/accounting.py publishes the recorded (category, detail) cycle-failure pairs.
